title: SafeNet
tagline: Decentralized disaster recovery platform, a portal for organizing efforts and resources to fight natural disaster events.
description:
The portal allows users to submit events that have been spotted all around the world. Once acknowledged by an admin, any user can then donate to the relief efforts for that particular event, be it in cryptocurrencies or actual materials.

Teams of trained professionals are assigned each event based on how close they are to where the event took place, they will be able to update the information and resources on the event.

Information is perpetually stored, guaranteeing that it can be seen at any point in time, and that it is transparent and unmodified.
how_its_made:
The front end is designed with tailwind and and web3modal, code is written in typescript.
The backend is developed on next.js along with react-js. Data is recorded on polybase, a web3 native database.

Sponsor techonology used is lighthouse, we feel is really beneficial to guarantee permanent storage for this kind of information.
